name: Foliobin
summary: Curated gallery of portfolios by designers behind products like Anthropic, Figma, OpenAI and Spotify, with video previews.
description: A curated gallery of portfolio websites by designers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, T-Bank and other product teams, built by Nikita Petrov. Entries carry video previews and an AI search that finds a similar portfolio from a picture; submissions are reviewed by hand (about one in four are accepted) and a Tuesday digest mails five picks.
contains: AI search that finds a similar portfolio from a picture
weekly Tuesday digest email with five picks
